search_window.basis: Nominal previous scheduled hourly check; last successful prior checkpoint could not be verified.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary high-value recall watch; production nationwide collection remains authoritative.
miss_classes: Loss of a community's only/last/full-service grocery store after fire, disaster or closure
Emergency food distribution cancellation or suspension caused by storm, flood, fire, outage or damage
Abrupt food pantry/food bank shutdown or material reduction in access
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No newly published and independently verifiable qualifying disruptions found within the nominal prior-hour window.
coverage_notes.freshness_limitations: Search indexing surfaced multiple older events (May–September 2026), one Oct 21 pre-announced Kenosha Food Bank closure effective end of 2026, and an Oct 23 SNAP proposed rule without a current access interruption. These were excluded. A negative result is not proof of comprehensive nationwide absence.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Excluded stale incidents, deferred future closure, rule proposal, donation drives, resource guides, promotions, opinion, non-disruption results and duplicates.
